source: docs/VENDOR_REFERENCE.md section 1 (Bloomberg: 1.1 entry points, 1.2 push-down grammar, 1.3 field map) and section 4; ADR-001 grafts 1-4. Statuses are copied from table 1.3; an entry not in that table says where it comes from in 'notes'. Template placeholders: {as_of} = absolute ISO as-of date; {d<N>} = as_of minus N calendar days; {as_of_1y} = as_of minus one calendar year; {start}/{end} = history window; {benchmark} = benchmark security. Every date is absolute (ADR graft 4: never '0D').

status_meaning.confirmed: Seen in vendor-authored code or docs in the form shown. May be compiled; still needs a field_validation_log entry (gate G5, see BloombergProvider.verify_fields) before production use as a filter predicate.
status_meaning.corrected: Verified only in the form shown here. Use exactly this form; parts listed under 'verify' stay configurable.
status_meaning.unverifiable: Could not be confirmed. Configurable only, never hard-coded; preflighted on test_security before use; a failure suspends the leg (LEG NOT EVALUATED); never pushed as a BQL threshold.

base.notes: Must always be wrapped in filter() (1.2). It is today's universe: equitiesuniv(dates=) is UNVERIFIED, so a historical as_of is survivorship-biased. For backtests pass universe_expr="members('RAY Index', dates='{as_of}')" (subject to index entitlement).

backtest_example.notes: members(idx, dates=) is the confirmed point-in-time universe (1.3 'Universe'). Not used unless passed as universe_expr.

country.notes: Compiled as cntry_of_risk()=='<UniverseSpec.country>' in the inner (static) filter, exactly as the reference universe push-down does. cntry_of_risk() is ECONOMIC EXPOSURE, not the listing country (country_iso() semantics for equities UNVERIFIED): it only narrows the vendor universe; the canonical 'country' column (listing) is derived from the security's exchange code and the local engine re-checks it.

probe.notes: Item placed in get() when no feature condition is pushed (get and for are mandatory). get() never filters.

px_2y.notes: Two-year adjusted close series (a 200d SMA needs ~290 calendar days). Reference form with absolute dates. Helpers are expanded inline wherever a feature expression references #<helper>.

px_asof.notes: Close on as_of at BQL's default adjustment, the same basis as the confirmed 52-week-high form (which carries no ca_adj).

gics_sector.notes: GICS / BICS row. Pushed only as a single-label == / in (infix 'or' and '!=' in string BQL are not in the reference); the label must match allowed_values (case-insensitive) and is emitted in this canonical spelling, so no spec text is ever interpolated.

gics_industry.notes: classification_name('GICS',n) and gics_industry_name() unverifiable (1.3). Local only.

exchange.notes: Country/exchange (other) row: exch_code() unverifiable. Local only.

price.notes: Last price row; px_last with dates=/fill=/ca_adj= as in the confirmed series form, anchored to as_of. Same adjustment basis as the SMA series. Also used for UniverseSpec.min_price.

verify: .last() in string form is UNVERIFIED (1.3 SMA row)
sma_20.notes: SMA row: smavg(<px series, 2Y>, period=N).last('1'). The bare smavg(period=N) form is unverifiable and never used.

high_52w.notes: 52w high row, confirmed max(px_high(dates=range(-52W,0D), fill=prev)) form with absolute dates. The maxmin(...).with_additional_parameters(period=260)['maxline'] form is object-API only.

drawdown_from_52w_high_pct.notes: Drawdown from high row: px_last()/hi52 - 1, a fraction, so catalog percent x 0.01 (-45 % -> -0.45). Price and high both use BQL's default adjustment (the confirmed forms carry no ca_adj): a split inside the window can distort the vendor value; the push-down only narrows and the local evaluator re-checks on adjusted data.

rsi_14.notes: RSI 14 row lists rsi(close=px_last(), period=14) and RSI(<series>, period=14) as confirmed; the unanchored px_last() form would read today's prices, so the anchored series form is used. Period always passed explicitly.

verify: .last() in string form is UNVERIFIED (1.3 SMA row)
rel_volume_5d.notes: Volume ratio push-down (section 4): 5-session over 60-session average volume, as in the reference crit v5 > vol_mult * v60.

verify: .last() in string form is UNVERIFIED (1.3 SMA row)
rel_volume_20d.notes: Built from the corrected Avg volume N-day primitives.

return_1m_pct.notes: Total return row: fraction. The calendar window approximates 21 sessions: borderline names may differ from the local evaluator (which re-checks every survivor). Set pushdown=false in an override to keep it local.

return_12m_ex_1m_pct.notes: total_return over an absolute range ending one month before as_of.

rel_strength_3m_pp.notes: Relative strength row: broadcasting value() inside filter() is untested, so keep it as a column (never pushed).

volatility_20d_pct.notes: Realized vol row confirms volatility(calc_interval='252d'); an absolute calc_interval=range(...) is the grammar's form for risk items. Units unstated: z-score only until admitted. BDP VOLATILITY_30D unverifiable.

verify: dates= anchoring on implied_volatility is not shown in the reference
iv_30d_pct.notes: Implied vol 30d ATM row: the '<N>d' expiry format is confirmed; pct_moneyness unverifiable. Units unstated: never a threshold until admitted.

fcf_yield_pct.notes: FCF yield row: free_cash_flow_yield() is not in the cited notebooks; name and units unknown. Residual (section 4): admit it, or build it from admitted items, before it is ever a threshold.

ev_to_ebitda.expression: curr_entp_val(dates='{as_of}', fill='prev')/avail(ebitda(fpt='LTM', dates='{as_of}', fill='prev'), is_oper_inc(fpt='LTM', dates='{as_of}', fill='prev'))
ev_to_ebitda.notes: EV/EBITDA row (corrected form), anchored to as_of. avail() falls back to operating income where EBITDA is missing and a negative EBITDA gives a negative ratio; the catalog value is NaN in both cases, so the vendor side can only keep extra names (the local evaluator drops them), never drop a name the catalog would keep. BDP EV_TO_T12M_EBITDA / BEST_CUR_EV_TO_EBITDA unverifiable.

ev_to_sales.notes: EV/Sales row, anchored. BDP EV_TO_T12M_SALES unverifiable.

enterprise_value_usd_bn.unit: raw units of the security's currency (currency conversion not shown)
enterprise_value_usd_bn.notes: Enterprise value row. No currency='USD' form is shown for curr_entp_val(), so it is not pushed as a USD threshold until admitted.

net_debt_usd_bn.unit: raw units of the reporting currency (conversion not shown)
net_debt_usd_bn.notes: Net debt row. Currency not shown: z-score only until admitted.

net_debt_to_ebitda.notes: Net debt / EBITDA row (corrected form). net_debt_to_ebitda() and BDP NET_DEBT_TO_EBITDA are unverifiable and never used. A negative EBITDA gives a negative vendor ratio where the catalog value is NaN, which can only keep extra names.

operating_margin_pct.notes: Operating margin row: oper_margin() / BDP OPER_MARGIN unverifiable; the alternative from confirmed items is used. Fraction, so catalog percent x 0.01.

verify: fpt='LTM' for gross_margin (the reference shows gross_margin(fpt=..., fpo=...))
gross_margin_pct.notes: Gross margin row. Units unstated: z-score only until admitted.

revenue_growth_yoy_pct.notes: Revenue growth, trailing row: components confirmed; admit the combination in BQLX. Residual in section 4 and ADR step 4 until admitted (then set pushdown=true in an override). sales_growth(fpt='A', fpo='1') is FY1 FORWARD growth and is never substituted.

revenue_growth_ntm_est_pct.expression: sales_rev_turn(fpt='BT', fpo='1', dates='{as_of}', fill='prev')/sales_rev_turn(fpt='LTM', dates='{as_of}', fill='prev') - 1
revenue_growth_ntm_est_pct.notes: NTM consensus (Revenue NTM row, confirmed) over LTM revenue (confirmed component). The combination is not admitted, so residual. Not sales_growth(fpt='A', fpo='1') (FY1, a different meaning).

revenue_revision_3m_pct.notes: Estimate revisions row: <dated estimate>.pct_chg(); pct_chg units UNVERIFIED, so z-score only.

target_price_upside_pct.notes: Analyst target row: the reference 'Upside' item best_target_price()/px_last() - 1, anchored to as_of.

short_interest_pct_float.notes: No BQL item known; BDP SHORT_INT / EQY_FLOAT (community code only, may need a securities-finance entitlement). Residual: evaluated locally on ALL push-down survivors before any ranking or top-N (ADR graft 2). If a BQL item is admitted, set expression/status here and the compiler pushes it inside filter(), still before any ranking.

days_to_cover.notes: BDP SHORT_INT_RATIO is unverifiable and its volume denominator may differ from the catalog's 20-session average. Computed locally.

put_call_volume_ratio.notes: BDP PUT_CALL_VOLUME_RATIO_CUR_DAY; BQL options() + put_call(): unverifiable.

macd_line.notes: macd(<series>)['MACD2'] is confirmed only as a column name; whether MACD2 is the MACD line is not. Computed locally (fallback emavg(12)-emavg(26)).

avg_dollar_volume_20d_usd_mn.notes: No verified single item (close x volume); computed locally. UniverseSpec.min_avg_dollar_volume_usd_mn therefore stays a local filter.

bql.notes: Used in the reference representative screen (1.2) but not a row of table 1.3. Preflighted.
GICS / BICS row.
gics_industry_name() unverifiable (1.3). Preflighted.
exch_code() unverifiable (1.3). value_map: Bloomberg exchange codes to canonical labels (not in VENDOR_REFERENCE; verify). Unmapped codes pass through unchanged.

derived.notes: Listing country from the exchange code inside the Bloomberg id ('AAPL US Equity' -> 'US'). Not a vendor field: cntry_of_risk() is economic exposure and country_iso() is UNVERIFIED, so neither is substituted for the listing country. Unmapped codes give NaN (excluded by the local country filter).
Trading currency of a US listing. Not a vendor field.

bql.notes: No BQL security-type item is verified and 'ADR/REIT exclusion not yet possible in BQL' (1.3). Members of equitiesuniv(['ACTIVE','PRIMARY']) are LABELLED with 'assume' (a warning says ADRs/REITs are not excluded) so the local common-stock filter does not empty the universe. Set expression to an admitted item to classify instead.

refdata_service.notes: Desktop API reference/history service (1.1). //blp/bqlsvc is PROHIBITED (ADR section 7) and never used.

timeout_ms.notes: nextEvent timeout used by the reference bdp().

history.notes: HistoricalDataRequest with startDate/endDate as YYYYMMDD (1.1 BDH example).

history_adjustment.notes: Element names from the BLPAPI Core Developer Guide; not fact-checked in VENDOR_REFERENCE. Without them BDH prices are not dividend-adjusted. If the request rejects them the adapter retries without and warns.

beqs.notes: BeqsRequest elements screenName, screenType (PRIVATE/GLOBAL), Group, optional asOfDate (no languageId). Used by the blpapi backend when universe_expr names a saved EQS screen. The asOfDate string format is not in the reference (VERIFY).

benchmark.notes: Benchmark in the reference relative-strength item. A price index (not total return).

transcript.notes: No BQL/BDP item. Terminal DS/CF/EVTS, ASKB, Document Insights; BQuant Enterprise Textual Analytics. API undocumented and LLM export rights unconfirmed: not fetched by this adapter.

news.notes: EDF Textual News is black-box use only (L5): never reaches the model.

research.notes: Broker research is Terminal BRC/DS/ASKB only (L6): never reaches the model.

filing.notes: Use SEC EDGAR directly (public, L0): aitrading.data.sec_edgar / the free provider.
